base.text: The driver-based forecast understated revenue by 3.1% compared to actual, while the naive forecast overstated it by 5.5%. Operating profit was understated by 14.9% in the driver-based forecast versus 22.3% in the naive version, indicating the driver-based approach improved profit estimation. Free cash flow was slightly understated by 3.4% in the driver-based forecast, contrasting with the naive forecast’s 14.8% overstatement, showing better alignment with actual cash generation.

upside.text: Upside scenario revenue of $25,822.1 million came in above actual revenue of $24,811 million, while operating profit of $2024.4 million was slightly below the actual $2056 million, resulting in a forecast miss on profit of -1.5%. Free cash flow at $1360.4 million significantly exceeded the actual $1106.4 million, reflecting strong cash generation in this scenario despite only modest revenue outperformance relative to actuals.

downside.text: The downside scenario shows revenue slightly above actual at 25,348.3 (missed upward by 2.2%), but operating profit at 14,80.3 fell well short of the 2,056 actual, understating it by 28.0%. Free cash flow at 783.9 also came in significantly below the actual 1,106.4, missing by 29.1%. While the scenario captures a revenue outcome close to reality, its profit and cash flow projections are notably pessimistic relative to what occurred.

wc_stress.text: Actual revenue was 24811, while the wc_stress scenario projected 25585.2, meaning the scenario overstated revenue by 3.1%. Similarly, operating profit came in at 2056 versus the scenario’s 1750.0, so the scenario understated operating profit by 14.9%. Free cash flow was 1106.4 actual, but the wc_stress scenario forecast only 429.6, indicating the scenario understated free cash flow by 61.2%.

margin_compression.text: Revenue missed actual by 3.1%, reflecting the impact of margin compression assumptions on growth expectations. Operating profit was understated by 39.8%, indicating the model failed to capture the depth of profit pressure embedded in the scenario. Free cash flow was significantly understated by 37.4%, driven by lower operating profit and higher working capital outflows relative to the actual result.

variance.text: Working capital reduced free cash flow by 372.3, the largest impact of any driver. Revenue growth added 89.8, EBITDA margin added 180.6, the effective tax rate added 42.8, and lower capex added 123.0. These opposing forces largely offset, yielding a small net increase of 37.2 despite substantial underlying movement in the assumptions. The residual of -26.6 reflects the portion of the variance not explained by the five drivers.
